description.en: High-quality, clean '00' (fino) aggregate suitable for construction and various other uses.
description.am: ከፍከፍተኛ ጥራት ያለው ለግንባታና ለተለያዩ አገልግሎቶች የሚውል ንጹህ 00 (ፊኖ) ጠጠር
description.om: Qulqullina olaanaa, cacii '00' (fiinoo) ijaarsaa fi itti fayyadama adda addaa biroof mijatu.
